about: [O3] debugging (not a proof): the cop's walk after a punch

steps.eval: (() => { const P = G.people, C = G.controller; P.dbgClear(); const E = G.eye, yaw = C.yaw, fx = -Math.sin(yaw), fz = -Math.cos(yaw); const v = P.dbgWalker(E.x + fx * 1.45, E.z + fz * 1.45, Math.atan2(-fx, -fz)); window.__o3v = v; const c = P.dbgCop(E.x + fx * 14 + fz * 1.2, E.z + fz * 14 - fx * 1.2, Math.atan2(-fx, -fz)); window.__o3c = c; return 1; })()

(window.__dbg = [], window.__dbgI = setInterval(() => { const c = window.__o3c; window.__dbg.push([+G.time.toFixed(1), c.job, c.mode, c.gaitNow, +c.fig.speed.toFixed(2), +c.pos.distanceTo(G.eye).toFixed(1), c.path ? c.path.length + ':' + c.pi : '-', G.police.state, G.police.heat, +c.pos.x.toFixed(1), +c.pos.z.toFixed(1)]); }, 700), 1)
